judgments.rewrite_hint: “Through Muse, trained human contract workers made some calls and completed the exchanges with users.” (MUSE-HC-006): remove “with users” so the sentence does not identify an unsupported counterparty; retain that workers made some calls and completed the exchanges.

“the user’s sensitive information might be shared with contract workers at a call center.
